findings.detail: The extracted MRO Holdings revolver row carries cost -327000 and fair value -336000, but the source MRO revolver row is cost -802000 and fair value -213000.
The extracted Triumph delayed draw row carries cost -84000 correctly, but the nearby extracted Triumph revolver row is cross-wired with the source MRO revolver values.
The source Triumph revolver row is cost -327000, fair value -336000, and maturity 7/24/2032, showing those values belong to Triumph rather than MRO.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. C107 surfaced negative costs, and negative costs can be legitimate, but the raw SOI shows at least the first flagged cluster has row-alignment defects: the bundle's MRO Holdings revolver negative cost/fair-value values match the source Triumph revolver, while the source MRO revolver has different negative cost and fair value. This is a real extraction/localization error, not merely a benign negative-cost false alarm.
